name: Vicmap Property
title: Vicmap Property
description:
Vicmap Property includes:

  • Parcel and property polygon views
  • Parcel and property Identifiers – Standard Parcel Identifiers (SPI) and council property numbers
  • Registered and proposed parcels
  • Crown and freehold land differentiation
  • Cadastral road casement boundaries
  • Easements
  • Unique Feature Identifiers, date stamps and data quality information
  • Cross reference to Vicmap Address and Vicmap Admin

Vicmap Property (land.vic.gov.au)
snippet: Vicmap Property is Victoria’s cadastral map base that provides information about land parcels and property details. The database is continuously maintained with information from authoritative sources within local and state governments.
